learnings: Tool errors on non-executable files (like .SRCINFO or .gitignore) should not cause an 'inconclusive' verdict when executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) were successfully reviewed and found safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file review failed due to API error' and 'file has security concerns' - the former should not block the overall verdict if critical files were reviewed
For packages with only metadata files and a PKGBUILD, a successful PKGBUILD review should be sufficient for a verdict even if metadata file review fails
